text:
Silver Price in 1980
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1980, the LBMA silver price fell 56.1% between 1980-01-31 ($35.28) and 1980-12-31 ($15.50). The highest sampled price was $35.52 in February and the lowest was $13.49 in March. The mean of these observations was $19.48. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 1980:
Gold and silver spiked to record highs in January 1980 amid double-digit inflation and the Hunt brothers' attempt to corner the silver market, then fell back sharply.
